title: Developer codemods and template evolution
summary: Reviewable TypeScript and Python transforms, AST rules, architecture checks and a real Copier template-upgrade fixture, with opt-in Rector and narrowly allowlisted OpenRewrite profiles.

profiles: Linux x86_64, Node 24.19.0: 3 tests passed using ts-morph 28.0.0, ast-grep 0.50.0 and dependency-cruiser 18.5.0.
Linux x86_64, Python 3.12.14: 4 tests passed with LibCST 1.9.0 and a real Copier 9.18.2 Git template upgrade.
notes: PHP/Composer and Java/Maven were unavailable in the local authoring environment. Dedicated CI jobs execute the Rector and allowlisted OpenRewrite profiles; receiving-app dry runs and behavior tests still require review.
OpenRewrite core 8.90.4 and Maven plugin 6.46.1 exact artifact POMs resolved with Apache-2.0 declarations. Only the declared core recipe scope is selected; external recipe bundles are excluded.
Copier writes only a disposable temporary Git fixture during tests. Conflicting receiving-app upgrades require diff review. No template tasks or installer hooks.
